appDescription.message: Chrome-native Side Panel controller for durable ChatGPT iteration workflows.

runFoundationDescription.message: Run directly against an explicitly selected ChatGPT tab using durable Repeat execution.

queueFoundationDescription.message: Create ordered queues of literal messages and reusable Templates, then run enabled items through the same durable lifecycle as Repeat.

presetsFoundationDescription.message: Save complete reusable run configurations while keeping direct runs first-class and preset-free.

templatesFoundationDescription.message: Create and manage reusable message templates with bounded variables and revision-safe working copies.

settingsFoundationDescription.message: Manage execution defaults, adapter health, bounded run history, and local data inventory.

futureCapability.message: Domain behavior is intentionally deferred to its roadmap owner.

targetDescription.message: Choose the exact ChatGPT tab this run owns. Changing the browser active tab never retargets an existing run.

noChatGptTabs.message: No eligible ChatGPT tabs are currently available.

presetDeferredHelp.message: Presets are optional. Apply one to hydrate this disposable working copy, or keep editing a direct configuration.

autoContinueHelp.message: Click ChatGPT Continue when a partial response exposes it.

autoScrollHelp.message: Scroll the target conversation to the bottom before sending.

noCurrentRun.message: No run has been started yet.

frozenExplanation.message: Chrome has frozen the target tab. DOM work cannot execute until Chrome unfreezes it, usually when the tab is activated.

discardedExplanation.message: Chrome discarded the target tab and unloaded its page. The run remains durable and will reconcile after the tab reloads and reconnects.

reconnectExplanation.message: The Side Panel is reconnecting to the extension runtime. The durable run continues under background authority.

failedExplanation.message: The run stopped because an execution error was persisted.

targetNotReady.message: Select a ready ChatGPT tab before starting.

invalidRunConfiguration.message: Enter a message, 1–10000 iterations, and a delay from 5–3600 seconds.

templateLibraryDescription.message: Load a saved template into a working copy. Names are labels; stable IDs remain the reference authority.

noTemplates.message: No templates have been saved yet.

templateEnabledHelp.message: Disabled templates remain saved but are not intended for execution references.

templateVariablesHelp.message: Supported variables are bounded to {iteration}, {total}, {remaining}, and {timestamp}. No scripts or expressions are evaluated.

templateDirtyGuard.message: This working copy has unsaved changes. Save As, Update, or Reset before replacing it.

templateStaleGuard.message: A newer saved revision exists. Your working copy was preserved; Reset reloads the latest saved revision.

preventDiscardHelp.message: Keep the target tab ineligible for automatic discard while this run remains active.

presetLibraryDescription.message: Load a saved complete run configuration into a revision-safe working copy. Presets remain optional for direct runs.

noPresets.message: No presets have been saved yet.

noQueuesForPreset.message: No queues exist yet. Queue authoring arrives in the Queue step.

presetDirtyGuard.message: This working copy has unsaved changes. Save As, Update, or Reset before replacing it.

presetStaleGuard.message: A newer saved revision exists. Your working copy was preserved; Reset reloads the latest saved revision.

queueLibraryDescription.message: Create ordered message queues for Queue-mode runs.

queueStaleGuard.message: This queue changed in the background. Reset before updating so local edits are not overwritten.

queueDirtyGuard.message: Reset or save the current queue edits before loading another queue.

queueModeDescription.message: Send each enabled queue item once, in order.

settingsDescription.message: Defaults hydrate future disposable Run drafts; they never rewrite an active durable run.

settingsStaleGuard.message: Settings changed in another context. Reset before saving so local edits are not silently overwritten.

defaultPresetUnavailable.message: Saved default preset is unavailable on this device

defaultPresetHelp.message: Optional. When available, this preset hydrates the initial Run draft; direct configuration remains first-class.

workerRecoveryHelp.message: Applies on the next extension-worker restart. Recovery still advances the durable generation fence before any execution resumes.

historyRetentionHelp.message: Keep at most this many terminal runs. Active and paused runs are never removed by history retention.

appearanceSystemHelp.message: Uses system fonts, native controls, CSS system colors, reduced-motion preferences, and forced-colors support. No private Chrome theme scraping.

diagnosticsDescription.message: Privacy-safe health projection for the bound ChatGPT adapter, runtime, tab lifecycle, database versions, migrations, and storage tiers.

inPageNoActiveRun.message: No active run on this ChatGPT tab.

inPageMultipleRuns.message: Multiple active runs target this tab. Open the Side Panel to manage them.

bindTabForDiagnostics.message: Bind a ChatGPT tab to inspect adapter selector health.

historyDescription.message: Browse bounded terminal-run summaries. Message bodies, composer drafts, and assistant text are not included.

dataDescription.message: Record counts and storage responsibilities are visible without exposing private payload contents.

portabilityNextHelp.message: Versioned configuration export/import and sensitive full backup are available in this Data section.

exportConfigurationHelp.message: Exports Templates, Presets, Queues, and Settings. Run history is excluded.

exportFullBackupHelp.message: Includes terminal run history and event payloads. Treat full-backup files as sensitive.

importMergeHelp.message: Keeps existing records when stable IDs collide and adds missing imported records.

importReplaceImportedHelp.message: Replaces records whose stable IDs are present in the file and leaves unrelated local records intact.

importReplaceAllHelp.message: Replaces all local configuration. Full backups also replace terminal history; active runs are preserved.

noImportSelected.message: Choose a portable JSON file before previewing.

targetReconnectExplanation.message: The target page is loading or its content adapter has not reconnected yet. Progress is suspended until the same tab is ready again.

browserSessionResetExplanation.message: The browser or extension session restarted. The run is paused to avoid duplicate sends because tab IDs are session-scoped. Select the intended ready ChatGPT tab on the previously bound conversation, rebind it, then resume.

conversationChangedExplanation.message: The target tab moved to a different ChatGPT conversation. The run is paused before another send. Return to the intended conversation or explicitly rebind the selected ready target, then resume.
